narrative.overview: A senior practitioner's workspace after hours: the room is dark, the focus is total, and one warm light pools on the work. The system defaults to a near-black canvas so the content reads as the lit subject. A single ember accent carries every moment of intent; everything else is a disciplined neutral ramp. Warmth comes from the accent, the generous type, and the tactile interaction, not from a warm-tinted background. Motion is restrained and intentional, and every animation has a reduced-motion fallback.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-default canvas with a fully supported light mode, both from one OKLCH neutral ramp.
One accent only: ember orange, on ≤10% of any screen.
Montserrat throughout; hierarchy from weight and scale; monospace only for small labels.
Confident, tactile interaction: magnetic CTA, custom cursor, soft lift on hover.
Motion is intentional and accessible with reduced-motion fallbacks.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ember is the only accent, used on ~10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point. No second accent hue.

rules.name: The True-Gray Rule
rules.body: Neutrals stay at chroma 0. Warmth comes from ember, type, and interaction, never a cream background.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Montserrat does the work alone. Hierarchy is weight + scale, never a second paired sans.

rules.name: The Caveat-Sparingly Rule
rules.body: The handwriting accent is one personal grace note per surface; never a heading, body, or label.

rules.name: The Lift-On-State Rule
rules.body: Cards are flat at rest; they respond with a neutral fill and a 1–2px translate, not heavier shadow.

dos: Do keep ember to ~10% of any screen: one CTA, one active state, one link that matters.
Do build hierarchy from Montserrat weight + scale; one family only.
Do keep neutrals at chroma 0; let warmth come from ember, type, and interaction.
Do hold WCAG AA: body ≥4.5:1, large text ≥3:1, the warm 2px focus ring on every interactive element, and a prefers-reduced-motion fallback for every animation.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and lift on state with a neutral fill and a small translate.
Do verify both themes: every choice must read in dark (default) and light.
donts: Don't ship the generic AI-template look: display-serif headings, a tiny uppercase eyebrow on every section, identical icon-card grids, or gradient text.
Don't drift into corporate-enterprise stiffness: safe navy-and-gray, stock photography, vendor-deck layouts.
Don't build a flashy dev-portfolio: particle backgrounds, neon, looping motion that competes with the work.
Don't be minimal to the point of bland: restraint must still carry a point of view.
Don't introduce a second accent hue; use weight, size, or a neutral step instead.
Don't warm-tint the background toward cream/beige; the canvas stays true gray.
Don't use heavy drop shadows as the affordance for interactivity; movement and fill signal it.
